scope.evidence_basis: Author rereading and explicit calculation of the fixed-node argument, with source support scoped as recorded. Checked inverse scaling K^-1(cv)=c^(1/alpha)K^-1(v), the bounded-unit-image constant and ||K(x)||<=C||x||^alpha. This proves the degree-one gauge and its compact embedding. Calculated ||K^-1(v)||L1<=T^(1-1/(alpha*p))*G^(1/alpha), using alpha*p>=1. Strong measurability of the inverse lifts is a separate explicit assumption, not a consequence of injectivity. The derivative and target norm are both E2: W11 provides all Lr bounds and the correct finite-p or supremum modulus, so Maitre applies. Arbitrary cones and noninjective maps are not declared equivalent.
